reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a thread under his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

On 2025-09-03, Priyanka posted in that channel that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. At 18:43 that day she said Southgate had cleared the backlog and closed the incident.

Tobias is a member of that channel, so I only used what he can already see. The channel names the site but gives no address or other details, and I found no Tansley account files in the share to add more.
